message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO regarding tech in schools
message.email_body: Zen van Riel, your video on GitHub's AI Boom caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth. We are reaching out regarding an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This collaboration offers a chance to develop useful content with an education consulting team and discuss a suitable collaboration format, helping your audience understand practical technology applications in educational settings. Would you be interested in exploring the idea together?
